messages:
maria: kicking off staged rollout for v3.2.1 to 5% eu-west during the 04:00-05:00 UTC change window. pinning to model-serving:v3.2.1
deploy-bot: queued rollout id=rl-20260320-73 — starting canary -> 5% on eu-west1
tom: noted, dashboards up and alerts on. i'll monitor latency and redis ops
oncall-sre: i'll watch SLOs and traces on-duty
jess: quick FYI — fallback is v3.2.0 pinned for immediate rollback if needed
deploy-bot: canary started at 04:00:12 UTC — 5% traffic; health checks passing
ryan: seeing tail latency +12% on some redis calls in the first minute, tagging traces
maria: any error spike?
jess: error rate +0.6% in 04:01 window, small but trending; not alarming yet
oncall-sre: digging into traces now — KV-cache miss rate jumped after new batching kernel
tom: plausible — the new batching default changed windowing. i can toggle batching override back to previous config
maria: decision: hold at 5%, do not increase. tom, please apply batching override and observe for 10m
deploy-bot: override applied by tom at 04:05:02 UTC (config: batching.window=old)
ryan: after override tail latency back to baseline, monitoring looks clean
jess: error rate flattened to +0.1%
maria: consensus check — go to 20% after 10m stable? :thumbsup:
oncall-sre: +1 for go
tom: +1, i'll keep override in rollout profile and keep v3.2.1 pinned
deploy-bot: scheduling traffic increase to 20% at 04:15:00 UTC. note: canary rollout id=rl-20260320-73. auto-pause thresholds: error delta>1% or latency>15% from baseline
maria: thanks all. i'll add these notes to the release checklist and post a summary in #release-notes. will reopen if alerts trigger
